        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));

        if (choose == 0 || choose == total) return 1;
        choose = Math.min(choose, total - choose);
        long res = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < choose; i++) {
            res = res * (total - i) / (i + 1);
        }
        return (int) res;
    }

    static double probability(int n, int x) {
        int term1 = combination(x, 3) * combination(n - x, 0);
        int term2 = combination(x, 2) * combination(n - x, 1);
        int term3 = combination(x, 1) * combination(n - x, 2);
        double numerator = (3.0 / 6.0) * term3 + term1 + term2;
        return numerator / combination(n, 3);
    }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = Math.min(i, r); j > 0; j--) {
                C[j] += C[j - 1];
            }
        }
        return C[r];
    }

    static double calcProb(int n, int x) {
        int c1 = nCr(x, 3) * nCr(n - x, 0);
        int c2 = nCr(x, 2) * nCr(n - x, 1);
        int c3 = nCr(x, 1) * nCr(n - x, 2);
        return (0.5 * c3 + c1 + c2) / (double) nCr(n, 3);

        if (k == 0 || k == n) return 1;
        k = Math.min(k, n - k);

        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            result = result * (n - i + 1) / i;
        }
        return result;
    }

        int a = choose(x, 3) * choose(n - x, 0);
        int b = choose(x, 2) * choose(n - x, 1);
        int c = choose(x, 1) * choose(n - x, 2);
        return (a + b + 0.5 * c) / (double) choose(n, 3);
    }

            val = val * (n - i) / (i + 1);

    static double getProbability(int n, int x) {
        int term1 = comb(x, 3) * comb(n - x, 0);
        int term2 = comb(x, 2) * comb(n - x, 1);
        int term3 = comb(x, 1) * comb(n - x, 2);
